# Docker images the integration tests pin. The tests read each cloud's image from here (the
# images_test.go of flociaws, flociaz, flocigcp and flocioci) and CI pulls every line, so each
# tag is declared once. One image:tag per line; '#' comments and blank lines are ignored. The
# library defaults stay the floating latest tag of each image; the examples use it too, as
# user-facing code.
floci/floci:2.2.0
floci/floci-az:0.14.0
floci/floci-gcp:0.10.0
floci/floci-oci:0.4.2
